components.name: Transaction Row
components.description: Mobile-first scan row for transaction history.

narrative.overview: Calm, trustworthy, mobile-first operational design. The interface makes financial and mosque information easy to scan without decorative noise; Public Display is treated as a separate read-at-a-distance surface.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Amanah Green is the primary accent; decorative gradients or arbitrary second accents are not part of the system.

rules.name: The Thumb First Rule
rules.body: Transaction flows must complete comfortably on small screens without zoom or horizontal scrolling.

rules.name: The TV Is Not a Big Laptop Rule
rules.body: Public Display must not inherit admin navigation or dashboard density merely because the screen is large.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Use spacing, typography, border, and tonal layering before adding shadows.

dos: Do start transaction flows from a single-column mobile layout.
Do make current balance and transaction amount easy to scan.
Do design Public Display as a dedicated TV surface.
donts: Don't use decorative gradients, glassmorphism, or neon SaaS styling.
Don't force desktop tables into horizontal-scroll mobile experiences.
Don't expose sensitive transaction evidence on Public Display.
